items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: I think he was married to, oh, Corrine.

ctx.x: Was he married once, do you remember, I think somebody told me he was, I never talked to him very much, I made some records once with him, but I never bothered him much, you know, to ask him questions. Do you know, was he ever married? Somebody told me you know who he was.
Well, I don't know. Well, I think he was married to, oh, Corrine. To a Cree?
